source.title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
source.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown
source.edition: CCEL expanded electronic edition of the 1871 public-domain text

entries.heading: 2. uprightness
entries.text: 2. uprightness --is the fruit of fearing God, as falsehood and ill-nature ( Pr 2:15; 3:32 ) of despising Him and His law.

entries.heading: 3. rod of pride
entries.text: 3. rod of pride --that is, the punishment of pride, which they evince by their words. The words of the wise procure good to them.

entries.heading: 4. crib is clean
entries.text: 4. crib is clean --empty; so "cleanness of teeth" denotes want of food (compare Am 4:6 ). Men get the proper fruit of their doings ( Ga 6:7 ).

entries.heading: 5. A faithful witness,
entries.text: 5. A faithful witness, &c.--one tested to be such. utter lies --or, "breathe out lies"--that is, habitually lies ( Pr 6:19 ; compare Ac 9:1 ). Or the sense is, that habitual truthfulness, or lying, will be evinced in witness-bearing.
6. An humble, teachable spirit succeeds in seeking ( Pr 8:9; Joh 7:17; Jas 1:5, 6 ).
7. Avoid the society of those who cannot teach you.
8. Appearances deceive the thoughtless, but the prudent discriminate.

entries.heading: 9. Fools make a mock at sin
entries.text: 9. Fools make a mock at sin --or, "Sin deludes fools." righteous . . . favour --that is, of God, instead of the punishment of sin.
10. Each one best knows his own sorrows or joys.
11. (Compare Pr 12:7 ). The contrast of the whole is enhanced by that of house and tabernacle, a permanent and a temporary dwelling.

entries.heading: 12. end thereof
entries.text: 12. end thereof --or, "reward," what results (compare Pr 5:4 ). ways of death --leading to it.
13. The preceding sentiment illustrated by the disappointments of a wicked or untimely joy.

entries.heading: 14. filled . . . ways
entries.text: 14. filled . . . ways --receive retribution ( Pr 1:31 ). a good man . . . himself --literally, "is away from such," will not associate with him.

entries.heading: 15. The simple . . . word
entries.text: 15. The simple . . . word --He is credulous, not from love, but heedlessness ( Pr 13:16 ).
16. (Compare Pr 3:7; 28:14 ). rageth --acts proudly and conceitedly.

entries.heading: 17. He . . . angry
entries.text: 17. He . . . angry --literally, "short of anger" (compare Pr 14:29 , opposite idea). man . . . hated --that is, the deliberate evildoer is more hated than the rash.

entries.heading: 18. inherit
entries.text: 18. inherit --as a portion (compare Pr 3:35 ). are crowned --literally, "are surrounded with it," abound in it.
19. Describes the humbling of the wicked by the punishment their sins incur.
20. This sad but true picture of human nature is not given approvingly, but only as a fact.
21. For such contempt of the poor is contrasted as sinful with the virtuous compassion of the good.
22. As usual, the interrogative negative strengthens the affirmative. mercy and truth --that is, God's ( Ps 57:3; 61:7 ).

entries.heading: 23. labour
entries.text: 23. labour --painful diligence. talk . . . penury --idle and vain promises and plans.
24. (Compare Pr 3:16 ). foolishness . . . folly --Folly remains, or produces folly; it has no benefit.
25. Life often depends on truth-telling. a deceitful . . . lies --He that breathes out lies is deceit, not to be trusted ( Pr 14:5 ).
26. The blessings of piety descend to children ( Pr 13:22; 20:7; Ex 20:6 ).
27. (Compare Pr 13:14 ). fear of the Lord --or, "law of the wise," is wisdom ( Ps 111:10 ).
28. The teaching of a true political economy.

entries.heading: 29. slow . . . understanding
entries.text: 29. slow . . . understanding --(Compare Pr 14:17 ). hasty --(Compare Pr 14:17 ). exalteth folly --makes it conspicuous, as if delighting to honor it.

entries.heading: 30. A sound heart
entries.text: 30. A sound heart --both literally and figuratively, a source of health; in the latter sense, opposed to the known effect of evil passions on health.

entries.heading: 31. reproacheth his Maker
entries.text: 31. reproacheth his Maker --who is the God of such, as well as of the rich ( Pr 22:2; Job 31:15 ; and specially 1Sa 2:8; Ps 113:7 ).

entries.heading: 32. driven
entries.text: 32. driven --thrust out violently (compare Ps 35:5, 6 ). hath hope --trusteth ( Pr 10:2; 11:4; Ps 2:12 ), implying assurance of help.

entries.heading: 33. resteth
entries.text: 33. resteth --preserved in quietness for use, while fools blazon their folly ( Pr 12:23; 13:16 ).

entries.heading: 34. Righteousness
entries.text: 34. Righteousness --just principles and actions. exalteth --raises to honor. is a reproach --brings on them the ill-will of others (compare Pr 13:6 ).

entries.heading: 35. wise
entries.text: 35. wise --discreet or prudent. causeth shame -- ( Pr 10:5; 12:4 ) acts basely.
